gizmo.title: Disqus
gizmo.description: Embed Disqus comments on a page.

configure.title: Short name
configure.description: The site short name, which drives the Disqus script host.

configure.title: Page URL
configure.description: The URL of the page the comment thread is attached to.

configure.title: Page identifier
configure.description: The unique identifier for the page comment thread.

configure.title: Page title
configure.description: The title of the page the comment thread is attached to.

configure.title: Loading text
configure.description: Text announced while the comments are loading.

configure.title: Language
configure.description: Language code for the Disqus interface, e.g. en.
